Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber grill.  I moved up to the Spirit E-310 for the additional grilling space.  Once again, my Weber is a top-shelf product, built very well, with great features, and simply, it grills like no other competitor.  Highly recommended!
Results.Title: Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: Worth the extra money!   Cooks evenly and easy cleanup.
Results.Title: Love the grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill—with one exception—it’s way too difficult to attach it filled propane tank to the gauge inside that shows the level of propane left in the tank. And the hold up the tank fits in is too wide – – so the tank and sub sitting on the deck.
Results.Title: Fitting the propane tank inside

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great grill. The only reason I gave 4 stars was the fuel gauge doesn’t work
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Can’t wait to start smoking on our Weber again. Tried the pellet thing. Still have it and use it a lot also but better smoke flavor with real wood chips on grill than pellets.  Just a little more babysitting involved but worth it. Best grills ever made. Our son still uses our 22 year old one and loves it. Striker still works. Amazing product. Well worth the money over buying a new grill every 2-3 years
Results.Title: Best brand you can buy

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grille easy to clean, even heat, and  quick start up.
Results.Title: Excellent Grille

Results.ReviewText: Great versatility between using various burners to cook using the direct or indirect methods for grilling. Able to get great results with thick or thin cuts of meat. Did an awesome job on kabobs also
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Quick start. Easy and precise flame adjustment. The best grilling grate.  Nice to have the tank accessible from the front. And number 1 is 4 rolling/rotating wheels.
Results.Title: My first Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It was very easy to assemble, under an hour. It’s a great looking grill and a quality product. It’s also the perfect size for my back patio and grilling needs. Great investment, I’ll be a Weber guy for life.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is worth every penny! I grill on it almost every night!
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Igniter broke early on and a replacement has been on backorder for a month
Results.Title: Igniter broke early

Results.ReviewText: If you need to move it around, like out of the garage onto the patio, take out the LP tank. I broke off a wheel my first attempt.
Results.Title: Wheels

Results.ReviewText: My mom has raved about Weber grills for years!  After going through two Charbroils in six years I decided to buy quality!  Wow, was mom right!  Best built grill I’ve ever used!  Heavy duty, heats up fast and maintains its heat!  Can’t say enough!  Oh, and the 10 year warranty!  Way to believe in your product!
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: This is the first grill I have ever put together where everything fit together the way it was supposed to. Only gave it 4 stars because so far I have only used it once.
Results.Title: Quality Parts Fitment

Results.ReviewText: Looks great, heats up fast, cooks evenly, moves well (I roll it on the patio as per my mood), has two useful side shelves, lots of room in the cabinet for accessories.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-310 is perfect

We do not expect you to have issues with your new Spirit E-310 however, we encourage you to reach out to us at support@weberstephen.com or 1-800-446-1071 for assistance. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: So far the grill has performed excellent. I have had two Webers previous, the Q1000 and the Q2500 both of those grills had the burner prematurely go out and customer service was no help at all. There was not a lot to choose from so I hope this Spirit restores my faith in Weber
Results.Title: Third times a charm???

Results.ReviewText: Love it!  Love the cast iron grates and how heavy duty it is.
Results.Title: Must Have

Results.ReviewText: I am most pleased with my new Weber Spirit E-310 Gas Grill.  I have been using grill mats for fish, but the newly designed reversible grill bars make it much easier to successfully grill fish.  The location of the first and third burners allow me to conveniently use the entire center of the grill when cooking with indirect heat.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310 is well designed

Results.ReviewText: Quality Product from Weber and easy to purchase at Lowes
Results.Title: Quality as expected from Weber

Results.ReviewText: Overall satisfied. Heats up quickly and grills well. Only real complaint is I wish the end caps on grill front panel ( where burner controls are ) were made of metal instead plastic. Just cheapens the overall brand / look and unsure of long term durability / rigidity.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: Assembled the grill over the weekend, haven’t used it yet, but couldn’t believe how well the assembly instructions were drafted; no words, just pictures. Everything was clear, all the parts fit together seamlessly, it was such a fun project it made me want to purchase another Weber grill just to put it together; so satisfying!  Now on to grilling!
Results.Title: Fantastic assembly instructions

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
